counters log bait like evo cannon, magic

So, I was definitely a little bit um
worried here going up against log bait.

that I could still actually have a bad

of course, Assaf can play more than just

account for other things as well. And
right here is when I'm like, hold up. I
can just Golden Knight because he I like

because I knew that he would have a hard

because the deck is just so broken in my

well played by him kind of keeping the
